skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to analyze business issues in the agricultural sector and propose solutions.
Students will learn to conduct field research and gather data from agricultural businesses.
Students will develop critical thinking skills to evaluate and solve real-world agricultural business problems.
Students will improve their communication skills through group discussions and presentations.
Students will understand and apply management principles in the context of agribusiness.
Students will analyze agricultural policies and their impact on business operations.
Students will learn and apply research methodologies to study agricultural business issues.
Students will develop problem-solving skills to address challenges in the agricultural sector.
Students will demonstrate leadership skills in group projects and presentations.
Students will manage and complete internship projects effectively.

prerequisite_courses: Foundation courses in the field of agribusiness
